content: For example jumptable is cached in every clients, but clients differ on what is saved in it, Reth/Nethermind/Besu save jumpdest in it, while Geth/Erigon save push immediates. So on this border case when hardfork happens and opcode get activated there is edge case and complexity.

content: Removal of CALLDEST would make this a lot simpler and desirable as it will not touch analysis.
